conclusion.cash_bond_delivery_route: NOT_FEASIBLE under case evidence: the actual delivery relationship requires the exact official deliverable bond, conversion factor, approved custody route, cash-bond pricing/carry and delivery process. Those dated inputs are not present for a reproducible ledger.
conclusion.etf_substitute: NOT_FEASIBLE as a cash-and-carry lock: the disclosed ETF is a fund using optimized sampling, not a contract-deliverable bond. It may be studied only as an unvalidated relative-value hedge, not as a convergence guarantee.
conclusion.personal_execution: NOT_FEASIBLE under case evidence: exchange-level rules show a possible customer/delivery framework, but this case holds no individual trading-code, broker-route, custody-account, delivery-process, commission, margin or execution evidence.
conclusion.strict_target: NOT_FEASIBLE: the case cannot establish, and must not claim, that every full calendar year or the annualized net return of every completed rolling five-calendar-year window clears 5% after costs.
conclusion.why_actual_contract_samples_do_not_close: The frozen CFFEX CSV files prove a currently reachable source route for actual contracts on six retrospective dates. They are neither complete point-in-time history nor executable two-leg evidence, so they cannot support a return test.

next_research_gate: Acquire a licensed or authorized point-in-time dataset covering actual T contracts, lifecycle/calendar, delivery basket and conversion factors, eligible cash-bond pricing/accrual/coupon data, and a documented data right.
Obtain dated broker documentation for commission, margin, cash-bond/ETF route, custody and delivery operations; do not store personal data in the case.
Freeze the exact paired-leg/no-fill/cost/roll/marking rules before looking at a result, then independently recompute every eligible annual and rolling-five-year window.
If any required field remains missing, retain NO_ACTION_AND_NOT_TESTABLE rather than substituting a continuous series, generic ETF return or invented fill.
no_action_statement: No external order, account opening, broker contact, cash-bond/ETF purchase, futures sale, short sale, repo, delivery submission or allocation is authorized by this research artifact.

source_scope.actual_contract_source_scope: Six retrospectively captured official CFFEX daily CSV samples, 2016--2026, each carrying actual listed contracts. This is a route observation rather than a full historical replay dataset.
rule_sources: CFFEX dated T contract and Treasury-futures delivery rules

verified_mechanics.evidence: Six official CSV samples contain actual T/TF rows; the dated 2026-08-14 T screen selects T2612 under the frozen 60--150-calendar-day research filter.
CFFEX educational material defines clean-price basis as cash clean price less futures price times conversion factor, and net basis as basis less holding cost.
verified_mechanics.scope: mechanical definition only; no live basis or return has been calculated
verified_mechanics.topic: basis, conversion factor and carry concept

verified_mechanics.evidence: CFFEX delivery rules specify physical delivery, a deliverable book-entry Treasury, conversion factor, accrued interest and custody-account review; an unapproved account faces delivery-month position controls.
verified_mechanics.scope: dated exchange rule; no customer account outcome is inferred

verified_mechanics.evidence: The 2020-effective T rule states a 2% base minimum margin, 3% from settlement two trading days before delivery, and client single-side limits of 4,000 lots from listing and 1,200 lots from the trading day before the delivery month. The current CFFEX product page also displays a 2% base minimum margin.
verified_mechanics.scope: Dated/product-page exchange framing only; it is not a complete effective-session history or a broker-specific margin/limit result.

verified_mechanics.evidence: The 2023 SSE rule says ordinary investors may trade listed Treasury bonds, while intermediaries must apply suitability and transaction controls.
verified_mechanics.scope: generic market-rule context only; no exact delivery bond, stock availability, settlement or custody match is established

verified_mechanics.evidence: SSE disclosure describes 511260 as an ETF using optimized sampling of index constituent Treasuries with a tracking objective.
verified_mechanics.scope: does not make an ETF share a delivery instrument or validate an ETF/futures return
